leadText:
Pokémon - The Journey of One Dream (Chinese: 同梦之旅 Tóngmèng zhī Lǚ, transl. The Journey of a Shared Dream) is a 12-minute short that was released on Weibo and Bilibili in on February 28, 2023 in celebration of Pokémon Day, on YouTube in on September 15, 2023 to commemorate the launch of Pokémon GO in Hindi, and on YouTube in Indonesia on February 19, 2024 in celebration of Pokémon Day.

It was announced on Weibo on February 23, 2023.

Pokémon - The Journey of One Dream (Chinese: 同梦之旅 Tóngmèng zhī Lǚ, transl. The Journey of a Shared Dream) is a 12-minute short that was released on Weibo and Bilibili in on February 28, 2023 in celebration of Pokémon Day, on YouTube in on September 15, 2023 to commemorate the launch of Pokémon GO in Hindi, and on YouTube in Indonesia on February 19, 2024 in celebration of Pokémon Day.

It was announced on Weibo on February 23, 2023.

==Other posters and logos==
 
The Journey of One Dream poster.png|Chinese poster
The Journey of One Dream English logo.png|English logo
 

==Plot==
Vin is a boy whose father is too busy with work to play with him. One day, Vin found a collection of Pokémon games and Nintendo handhelds under the couch, and decides to boot up the copy of on the Game Boy. He is mysteriously sucked into the world of the game, and meets a young Pokémon Trainer who calls himself Lord Dominic, who Vin notes has the same name as his father. He exits the world of the game after being attacked by a .

Vin begins playing on the Game Boy Color, and again finds himself sucked into the game. There, he finds himself in the Whirl Islands riding a with Dominic, and exits the game after getting splashed while crossing a . Vin's father scolds him for being too loud, and Vin remarks that he wishes his father was more like Dominic in the game. Vin continues playing, and finds himself with Lord Dominic soaring in the sky in , battling at Spear Pillar in , battling N at N's Castle in , and battling at the Team Flare Secret HQ in . Vin realizes that the Dominic in the game is the same person as his father, and wonders why his father doesn't play with him like he does in the game.

Vin starts playing and finds himself alone in Ultra Space. During a break in his father's work, Dominic discovers that his son is inside the cartridge, and he immediately goes after him to save him. After saving his son, the two accidentally go on an Ultra Warp Ride and land in Ultra Space Wilds, where they encounter a . During the battle, Dominic is forced to use all of the Pokémon in his party and is still defeated, causing him to Mega Evolve his Charizard. In order to have a chance of victory, Vin reminds him to use his secret technique involving the move that he learned about while playing with Lord Dominic in Pokémon Y. With the help of his son and , Vin and Dominic manage to escape and return to the real world.

After celebrating their battle, Dominic returns to his work, but Vin notices that something has changed about him. In the epilogue, inside two Nintendo Switch consoles with Pokémon Sword and Shield, Dominic and Vin participate side by side, as Lord Dominic and Vin the Invincible, in a Pokémon battle against two Trainers.
